- Technical CS engineer (support): Lauren Bishop — SSO/SCIM, VPC connectivity, and troubleshooting
- Escalation contact (sales): Jonas Weber — contract/terms/questions

Onboarding & evaluation milestones (dates are target):
1) Kickoff & MAP review — 2025-11-06 (owner: Marissa)
2) Environment provisioning (test cluster / API keys) — 2025-11-10 (owner: Lauren)
3) Sample ingestion & baseline eval (10k messages) — 2025-11-13 (owner: Voltiva / Samir)

- Success metrics: latency P95 < 650ms for standard pathways, precision@K = 0.78 (target), false positive rate < 2.5% on moderated classes.
- Rollback: if quality regresses beyond the threshold at validation, we will pause rollout and open a tuning incident (CS owns incident coordination).
